caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp nori seaweed. A watermelon slice and bean sprouts garnish the noodles in a white bowl with red geometric trim, set against a warm wooden background under soft, inviting light.

segments_info.text: The table surface appears smooth, light brown wood grain with subtle texture and soft highlights.
Chashu pork: browned, textured, rectangular slice with visible fat marbling and slightly charred surface.
Nori seaweed, dark green and textured, appears as a rectangular strip with uneven, slightly curled edges and visible grainy surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and clear, with thin noodles submerged and visible surface oil sheen.
White ceramic bowl with red geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly glossy surface and rounded, tapered shape.
